title: Check ruling: setup that names meaning-holders rebinds to the architect holding the context
situation: Under 0086 the lead retires the ledger's way of naming a context's meaning-holder in favour of naming the architect that holds it, keeping the refusal of one cut across contexts held by different architects. Frozen checks of other examples, visible and held out, use the old form only in their setup, and some architect scenarios seed a list of meaning-holders.
decision: Yes. Setup-only uses rebind to the architect form: each named holder becomes the architect holding those contexts, and the seeded list of meaning-holders is removed. No assertion, rubric, threshold or example text changes; each affected check is shown still green after the rebind and red against work that refuses the new form.
consequences: The retired meaning-holder survives nowhere in what the cut delivers or in its checks' setup.
